description: R08 CommandTests family checkpoint: safe Rust owns Microsoft SettingsModel command layering, splitPane validation/naming, resource-key naming, generated command names, and NewTerminalArgs commandline projection. All eight source methods are Exact.

entries.notes: Name-keyed command layering retains four independently named copy/paste commands even when action semantics repeat.
Later definitions replace the same command name across copy/paste/newTab and a null command removes the entry.
Rust reproduces Microsoft's nine splitPane vectors, including vertical→Right, horizontal→Down, directional values, Automatic defaults, and size 0.25.
Only split size 0.25 is admitted; 1.0, 0 and 50 produce three recoverable warnings and do not enter the command map.
The Microsoft resource-key vector DuplicateTabCommandKey resolves to the product display name Duplicate tab and retains CopyText semantics.
Unnamed splitPane actions collapse to five generated identities: base Automatic plus left/right/up/down directional names; null/none/auto/unknown/omitted share the base name.
An explicitly named Split pane command layers over the previously autogenerated Split pane identity without increasing cardinality.
Rust projects all nine Microsoft NewTerminalArgs commandline vectors, including profile, commandline payload quoting, trailing-backslash directory escaping, and tab-title quote/semicolon escaping.
